notes.title: It’s time to slither like it's 1976 in Cube Snake!
notes.content:
Welcome to the dystopian cyberpunk world of Cube Snake, where players navigate a 3D cubic environment, testing their munching and slithering prowess. With an isometric perspective and refreshing climbing mechanics, Cube Snake fuels the classic Snake game with more dimensions, colours and music!

In Cube Snake, the challenge is to gather fruit pouches while dodging your own tail and avoiding plummeting off the edges of the game's 3D world, if you ever played Snake before, you already know this much. The game was designed for endless replay value, and currently features a local three letter high-score, like on all our favourite arcade machines.

You're invited to try Cube Snake now, hope to hear your thoughts in the community section!

- KABUM

notes.title: Announcing a CLOSED Demo: Join us on Discord & request access!
notes.content:
Hi friends, 

We decided to run a first closed demo for our remake of the Classic Snake, called Cube Snake! It’s a 3D game with lots of added fun, but you already know all of this, as Cube Snake is in your wishlist, right?

In that case, we would like to invite you to the very first Cube Snake closed demo! 

We’ll be running the closed demo from October 2nd to October 7th, and invite you to play along by joining us on Discord. 

If you haven’t heard of Cube Snake before, here’s our game’s key features:

[list]
[*] Crawl: Navigate using just two buttons to slither around the floor and walls!
[*] Eat: Gather fruit pouches as they randomly appear, but don’t lose your balance!
[*] Grow: Every bite makes you longer—how long can you keep your snake growing?
[*] Survive: Stay away from your own tail and the red line, or it’s game over!
[*] Score: Compete for the highest score, both personally and on global leaderboards!
[/list]

[b]Also Brand New:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fever Mode: We’re testing out the fever mode for the first time, a random event speeding things up and adding tons of food on the map - making things extra snakey!
[/list]

We’re also going to give away four gorgeous 3D Snakes! Reach the two highest scores or share the two best pieces of feedback, and one will be yours:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110307/1eed6963578e460f425c5e762214c98413eeb2d0.jpg[/img]

So, slither on over, claim your spot, and see how long you can make your snake, by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/kabum-557576677371412520]Discord [/url] community and requesting access. 

Lastly, while not join us on [url=http://linkedin.com/company/kabum-it]LinkedIn [/url] [url=http://tiktok.com/@kabum.it]TikTok [/url] [url=http://instagram.com/kabum.it]Instagram [/url] [url=http://twitter.com/kabum_it]X [/url] [url=http://facebook.com/kabum.makeitreal]Facebook[/url] [url=http://youtube.com/@kabumfilmexperience]YouTube[/url]

Thank you!

KABUM

notes.title: We’re Bringing You Back to the Future With our Retro-Futuristic Cube Snake
notes.content:
Get ready to relive the fun of the classic Snake game with a modern twist! We're Kabum, an indie game developer from Bari, Italy, and we're excited to reveal Cube Snake—a 3D remake of the beloved retro game. 

In Cube Snake, you’ll slither through a dystopian cyberpunk map, eating fruit pouches, growing longer, and climbing walls without falling off. This game is perfect for killing time, so if you’re a serial procrastinator, wishlist the game now!

Our goal with the game is to feature a demo in September’s Next Fest, and launch on PC and Android a little later, still in 2024. Cube Snake’s premise is very simple, and with a small download, we see it as a game you can play whilst traveling, sitting on the loo, or even between rounds of your other games. Need a break from your MOBA/FPS spree? Jump in Cube Snake for a round! Do you like streaming games? Play a round or two of Cube Snake whilst you speak to your chat and choose your next game!

If you’ve got the competitive spirit, Cube Snake is also one for you, as we’ll feature hi-scores to show off just how long you made your snake!

Game Features:

[list]
[*] Crawl: Use two buttons to turn left and right and crawl on the floor and walls. It’s isometric
[*] Eat: Pay attention to where your food randomly spawns, and go munch it up
[*] Grow: Every time you eat, your tail grows longer, so get lengthy
[*] Survive: Be careful not to cross the red line and… not to eat your own tail
[*] Score: The higher the better, but if it's short, it's okay too—aim to beat your own score
[/list]

Cube Snake is now available for wishlisting on Steam for PC, and will be launching on Steam and Android for Mobile Devices in 2024.

We invite you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/kabum-557576677371412520]Discord [/url]and follow us on all of our links below. Don't forget to wishlist our first ever game, every wishlist helps more than you might think!
